description: This file contains unit tests for the InboundEmail class and related functionality within the SuiteCRM project. It includes tests for connecting to mail servers, managing folders, caching, email processing, and various utilities related to inbound email handling.

classes.name: InboundEmailTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that tests various functionalities and behaviors of the InboundEmail module within SuiteCRM, including connection handling, folder management, caching, email processing, and more.
